answer: Proof-of-stake provides robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as a stake, turning a voyage into a verifiable economic commitment. Just as a rare opal possesses a unique structural pigment, each validator identity must be backed by tangible assets. An attacker faces prohibitive costs, as they must acquire a majority of the circulating supply to compromise consensus, ensuring that network influence remains proportional to documented financial risk rather than ephemeral digital signatures.
